headline: SEA @ OAK matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SEA 3.95 at OAK 3.19, with a projected total of 7.14. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward OAK: SEA moved -0.94 runs while OAK moved -0.52, changing the projected margin by -0.41 runs. The projected total fell -1.46, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Logan Gilbert has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Julio Rodríguez, Nick Kurtz, Josh Naylor, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Rob Refsnyder, Brent Rooker because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
